description: This file defines the PrivilegeListener interface in the org.openmrs package, used for tracking privilege checks within OpenMRS. It includes a callback method invoked when a privilege check occurs, allowing implementation of privilege monitoring or logging.

classes.name: PrivilegeListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to privilege check events. Implementations will be notified whenever a privilege is checked, with details about the user, privilege name, and whether the user has the privilege.

methods.name: privilegeChecked
methods.description: Callback method invoked whenever a privilege is checked. Receives the user, the privilege being checked, and whether the user has the privilege.
